svg.title: An LE 1M advertisement observed by ESPARGOS

cc:Work.dc:title: An LE 1M advertisement observed by ESPARGOS
cc:Work.dc:description: Actual BLE channel 37 captures from three ESPARGOS sensors, with one absent sensor shown. Baseband I is shown before and after packet alignment, with the same packet interval shaded. Independent scales and vertical offsets make timing visible.
